title: Identification and functional analysis of three novel osteogenic peptides isolated from tilapia scale collagen hydrolysate.
authors: Huang, Wen; Yu, Kenan; Kang, Meng; Wang, Qiaoe; Liao, Wanwen; Liang, Peng; Liu, Guo; Cao, Yong; Miao, Jianyin
one_liner_zh: 该文从罗非鱼鳞胶原水解物中筛选成骨肽，虽用分子对接研究肽与EGFR互作，但对象为肽-蛋白而非蛋白质-DNA，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: On the basis of our previous study that 133 peptides were identified from the tilapia scale peptide-calcium chelate, the potential osteogenic peptide monomers through the calcium-binding properties of peptides and molecular docking were screened, and the osteogenic activity and active mechanism of the peptides were further researched in this study. Three highly osteogenic peptides GPAGPHGPVG (844.4191 Da), APDPFRMY (995.4534 Da), and TPERYY (827.3813 Da) were screened. Molecular docking showed that the three osteogenic peptides had the same interaction sites in the epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR), namely ARG 285, GLN 8, GLY 317, THR 406, and HIS 409. Compared to the blank control group, within 50 mug/mL of GPAGPHGPVG, APDPFRMY, and TPERYY increased the proliferation of MC3T3-E1 cells by changing the cell proportion in the S and G2/M phases, and the alkaline phosphatase (ALP) activity of MC3T3-E1 cells treated with 50 mug/mL of the three active peptides increased by 25%, 37%, and 56%, respectively. The three active peptides at 10 mug/mL concentration significantly promoted the mineralization of osteoblasts, and the mineralized calcium nodules increased by 166%, 161%, and 111%, respectively. TPERYY significantly increased the expression of osteogenic genes (osteocalcin (OCN), type I collagen (Col I alpha) and transcription factor (OSX)). Moreover, TPERYY significantly increased the mRNA and protein expression of beta-catenin to 1.39 and 2.6 times of the blank control group, respectively, while decreased the mRNA and protein expression of glycogen synthesis kinase (GSK3beta) to 1.6 and 2.3 times of the blank control group, respectively. This study provides a theoretical basis for using GPAGPHGPVG, APDPFRMY, and TPERYY peptides as functional foods to prevent osteoporosis.
abstract_zh: 基于我们先前从罗非鱼鳞片肽-钙螯合物中鉴定出133种肽的研究，本研究通过肽的钙结合特性和分子对接筛选了潜在的成骨肽单体，并进一步研究了这些肽的成骨活性及活性机制。筛选出三种高成骨活性肽：GPAGPHGPVG（844.4191 Da）、APDPFRMY（995.4534 Da）和TPERYY（827.3813 Da）。分子对接显示，这三种成骨肽在表皮生长因子受体（EGFR）上具有相同的相互作用位点，即ARG 285、GLN 8、GLY 317、THR 406和HIS 409。与空白对照组相比，在50 μg/mL浓度下，GPAGPHGPVG、APDPFRMY和TPERYY通过改变细胞在S期和G2/M期的比例促进了MC3T3-E1细胞的增殖，且用50 μg/mL的这三种活性肽处理的MC3T3-E1细胞的碱性磷酸酶（ALP）活性分别增加了25%、37%和56%。在10 μg/mL浓度下，这三种活性肽显著促进了成骨细胞的矿化，矿化钙结节分别增加了166%、161%和111%。TPERYY显著增加了成骨基因（骨钙素（OCN）、I型胶原（Col I alpha）和转录因子（OSX））的表达。此外，TPERYY显著将β-连环蛋白的mRNA和蛋白表达分别提高至空白对照组的1.39倍和2.6倍，同时将糖原合成激酶（GSK3beta）的mRNA和蛋白表达分别降低至空白对照组的1.6倍和2.3倍。本研究为使用GPAGPHGPVG、APDPFRMY和TPERYY肽作为预防骨质疏松的功能食品提供了理论基础。
